Data.subject: Labour, Employment, Wages and Productivity
Data.title: Retrenched Term Contract Employees By Industry (SSIC 2020) And Occupational Group, Quarterly
Data.footnote: Previously know as Early Release of Contract Workers.  1) Before 2006, data pertain to private sector establishments each with at least 25 employees.  From 2006 onwards, it includes the public sector.  2) Data are rounded to the nearest 10, hence may not add up to the total.  3) Data are based on SSIC1996(1990-1999), SSIC2005(2000-2005), SSIC2020(2006-current).  4) Data are revised at the industry level to reflect updates in industry classification of firms based on SSIC 2020.  Revisions have also been made to the 2Q 2022 figures, following clarifications with survey respondents.
